blocks.text:
From Chile's vineyards, the route leads to the moai of Rapa Nui, then on to the dry valleys of the Atacama and the glaciers of Patagonia. After visiting Mendoza's wineries, you will see Iguazu from the Brazilian and Argentine sides and end your journey in Buenos Aires.

## Accommodation: 16 nights

| Stage | Nights | Hotel | Room category | Meals |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Santiago | 1 | The Singular Santiago | Lastarria Room | BB |
| Millahue / Cachapoal | 1 | VIK Chile | Master Suite | BB |
| Easter Island | 2 | Nayara Hangaroa | Kainga | BB |
| Santiago | 1 | The Singular Santiago | Lastarria Room | BB |
| San Pedro de Atacama | 1 | Nayara Alto Atacama | Quitor | BB |
| Puerto Natales | 2 | The Singular Patagonia | Singular Room | BB |
| El Calafate | 2 | EOLO Patagonia | Corner Room | BB |
| Mendoza | 2 | Entre Cielos | Superior Room | BB |
| Iguazu, Brazil | 2 | Belmond Hotel das Cataratas | Deluxe Room | BB |
| Buenos Aires | 2 | Four Seasons Hotel Buenos Aires | Mansion-View Room | BB |

BB means breakfast. Room categories are listed as specified in the programme.

## Price

| Occupancy | Price per person |
|---|---:|
| Double | from $23,700 |

The price shown includes hotel accommodation and all ground services/excursions in the program. Private jet flights between regions are not included and are calculated separately, depending on the dates selected.

## Private aviation

The itinerary includes charter flights from Santiago to Easter Island and back (about 5.5 hours each), Santiago to Calama (about 2 hours), a flight to Punta Arenas, direct flights from Puerto Natales to El Calafate, El Calafate to Mendoza and Mendoza to Iguazu, followed by Iguazu to Buenos Aires (about 1 hour 45 minutes). Helicopter sectors and alternatives to road transfers are agreed separately. Flight times are approximate; aircraft availability and the feasibility of international private flights are confirmed when booking.
